notes.title: Improving Gameplay
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It has been six months since the release of the demo, and we have received a lot of valuable feedback from players.
We understand that the current gameplay does not fully meet expectations.
With our commitment to creating a great game, we have made the bold decision to improve the gameplay,
so that everyone can enjoy a richer and more dynamic gaming experience.

The game is still in active development, and we will do our best to meet your expectations!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We believe that after experiencing the two levels, you all must be wanting more. 
That's why we have specially prepared the second goddess—Ruri—to accompany you. 
The level with goddess Ruri features different areas, different actions for the reincarnation targets, and even different vehicle to drive! 
We welcome you after finishing the story, come and experience this brand new level.

notes.title: Joining the Steam Next Fest and releasing a demo.
notes.notes: ISEKAI Truck Driver has joined the Steam Next Fest and launched a demo. Let’s drive the truck and send all the targets to reincarnation!

notes.title: "ISEKAI Truck Driver" is announced
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

"ISEKAI Truck Driver" is officially announced today!

An accident brings you to the goddess, and what's even more unexpected,
you've become the ISEKAI Truck Driver who assists the goddess in transporting heroes to save the world!

You will traverse through towns, continuously searching for and transporting the heroes designated by the goddess.
By contacting the goddess, your relationship becomes closer and you can eventually engage in intimate behavior.
But as you encounter different goddesses, you will gradually find that the world is a little different from what you imagined? !

Between reality and isekai, there's another way of life for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2844730/_/
Add to your wishlist now and follow us. Goddesses from ISEKAI are waiting for you.
